name: Petronas Sepang International Circuit
coordinates: x east, z south, y up; meters
bank_convention: Positive bank raises the geometric left road edge relative to center

metadata.layout: Full Grand Prix circuit (5.543 km, 15 turns: 10 right, 5 left), clockwise; the back straight and pit straight joined by the Turn 15 hairpin

start_finish.source: OSM node 1578189278 (name=Start-Finish, raceway=start-finish) on the pit straight; not checked against the painted grid, which 10 m Sentinel-2 imagery cannot show

width.status: Published width; no open imagery fine enough to measure edges
